parts.name: Root
parts.description: State container for the menu. Shares open state, the trigger reference, and navigation settings (loop, typeahead, closeOnSelect) with all parts.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow navigation wraps around the ends.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether typeahead (type to focus a matching item) is enabled.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether selecting an item closes the menu. Items can override this.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the trigger element. Can be set manually or via Menu.Trigger.

props.name: children
props.description: Children (Trigger and Content).

parts.name: Trigger
parts.description: Button that opens the menu (aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded). ArrowDown/Enter/Space open and focus the first item; ArrowUp opens and focuses the last item.

props.name: children
props.description: Button content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the button.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered button element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the trigger button.

parts.name: ContextTrigger
parts.description: A surface that opens the menu on right click, long press, or Shift+F10 — anchored at the pointer. Renders a plain element rather than a button, so it can wrap arbitrary content.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the surface is disabled. The browser's own context menu is left alone.

props.name: longPress
props.description: Whether a long press opens the menu on touch and pen.

props.name: longPressDelay
props.description: How long a touch has to be held, in ms.

props.name: preventTouchCallout
props.description:
Whether to suppress the iOS text callout / selection on the surface. Long press
is unusable there without it; turn it off if the surface contains text the user
is meant to select.

props.name: tabindex
props.description:
Tab order position. Defaults to `0` so keyboard users can reach the surface and
open the menu with Shift+F10. Pass `-1` when the surface lives inside a composite
that already manages focus with a roving tabindex (a table, a tree).

dataAttributes.name: data-context-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Present on every context-menu surface.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the surface is disabled, leaving the browser's own menu in place.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Present on any element that opens a menu, context or not.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: `open` or `closed`.

parts.name: Content
parts.description: The floating role="menu" panel. Renders in a portal and positions itself against the trigger; also used as the panel of a submenu.

props.name: offset
props.description:
Offset along the main axis from the trigger element. Defaults to `4`, or to `0`
 for a context menu, which sits at the pointer like a native one.

props.name: placement
props.description:
Placement relative to the trigger element. Defaults to `bottom-start`
 for a root menu and `right-start` for a submenu.

props.name: shouldFlip
props.description: Whether to flip when there's insufficient space.

props.name: boundaryElement
props.description: Boundary element for positioning constraints.

props.name: shouldCloseOnEscape
props.description: Whether pressing Escape should close the menu.

props.name: shouldCloseOnInteractOutside
props.description: Whether interacting outside the menu should close it.

props.name: children
props.description: Content of the menu.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the menu container.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-content
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the menu panel element.

dataAttributes.name: data-placement
dataAttributes.description: The resolved side of the trigger the panel is on ("top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left").

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the menu is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Overlay
parts.description: Optional backdrop rendered behind the menu. Place it as a sibling of Menu.Content inside Menu.Root; in a submenu chain only the root menu should render one.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the overlay.

dataAttributes.name: data-entering
dataAttributes.description: Present while the enter animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-exiting
dataAttributes.description: Present while the exit animation is running.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-overlay
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the overlay element.

dataAttributes.name: data-state
dataAttributes.description: "open" while the menu is open, "closed" during exit.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: An interactive role="menuitem" action. Accepts `onAction`, `disabled`, `closeOnSelect` (overrides the Root default), `textValue` for typeahead, and an optional stable `value`.

props.name: value
props.description: Stable identifier (used for typeahead/navigation). Auto-generated if omitted.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Handler invoked when the item is activated.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item is disabled.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Override the Root `closeOnSelect` default for this item.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text used for typeahead matching. Falls back to the item's text content.

props.name: children
props.description: Item content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the item.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the item element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the item is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is highlighted via keyboard navigation or pointer hover.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id
dataAttributes.description: The item's stable identifier (its `value` prop, or an auto-generated id).

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id-type
dataAttributes.description: "number" when the item's `value` is numeric; absent for string ids.

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-item
dataAttributes.description: Marks the element as a keyboard-navigable menu item.

dataAttributes.name: data-pressed
dataAttributes.description: Present while the item is actively pressed via pointer.

dataAttributes.name: data-text-value
dataAttributes.description: The text typeahead matches against, when it differs from the label.

parts.name: Separator
parts.description: A visual divider between menu items (role="separator").

props.name: orientation
props.description: Orientation of the separator.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the separator.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the separator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-separator
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the separator element.

dataAttributes.name: data-orientation
dataAttributes.description: The separator orientation ("horizontal" | "vertical").

parts.name: Group
parts.description: Groups related items (role="group"), labelled by an optional Menu.GroupLabel via aria-labelledby.

props.name: children
props.description: Group content, usually a Menu.GroupLabel followed by Menu.Item parts.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the group.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the group element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-group
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group element.

parts.name: GroupLabel
parts.description: Accessible label for a Menu.Group. The surrounding group references it through aria-labelledby.

props.name: id
props.description: Optional explicit id (auto-generated otherwise).

props.name: children
props.description: Label content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the label.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the label element.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-group-label
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group label element.

parts.name: SubmenuRoot
parts.description: State container for a nested submenu. Place it inside a Menu.Content with a Menu.SubmenuTrigger and its own Menu.Content; navigation settings inherit from the parent menu.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state for uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Callback when open state changes.

props.name: loop
props.description: Whether arrow navigation wraps. Inherits from the parent menu by default.

props.name: typeahead
props.description: Whether typeahead is enabled. Inherits from the parent menu by default.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether selecting an item closes the menu. Inherits from the parent by default.

props.name: triggerRef
props.description: Reference to the submenu trigger element.

props.name: children
props.description: Children (SubmenuTrigger and Content).

parts.name: SubmenuTrigger
parts.description: A role="menuitem" that opens its submenu on hover, ArrowRight, Enter, or Space. Behaves as a navigable item of the parent menu.

props.name: value
props.description: Stable identifier (used for parent navigation). Auto-generated if omitted.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the trigger is disabled.

props.name: textValue
props.description: Text used for typeahead matching. Falls back to text content.

props.name: children
props.description: Trigger content.

props.name: class
props.description: CSS class for the trigger.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the trigger is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-highlighted
dataAttributes.description: Present while the trigger is highlighted via keyboard navigation or pointer hover.

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id
dataAttributes.description: The trigger's stable identifier (its `value` prop, or an auto-generated id).

dataAttributes.name: data-item-id-type
dataAttributes.description: "number" when the trigger's `value` is numeric; absent for string ids.

dataAttributes.name: data-menu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Marks the element as the trigger of its submenu.

dataAttributes.name: data-navigation-item
dataAttributes.description: Marks the element as a keyboard-navigable item of the parent menu.

dataAttributes.name: data-submenu-trigger
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the submenu trigger element.

dataAttributes.name: data-text-value
dataAttributes.description: The text typeahead matches against, when it differs from the label.
